overviewParagraphs: Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club occupies a welcoming position in Cambodia's golf landscape — a course designed for enjoyment first, where the generous fairway widths and thoughtful floral landscaping create a playing environment that is genuinely relaxing without sacrificing all scoring challenge. It is the course AGS recommends for groups looking to balance a great day of golf with beautiful surroundings and accessible playing conditions near the Angkor Wat temple complex.

The floral landscaping at Booyoung is genuinely striking — tropical flowering plants and manicured garden borders give the course the visual warmth of a botanical garden, with the golf fairways threading through what feels at times like a cultivated flower estate rather than a conventional golf facility. The effect is immersive and deeply pleasant, creating an atmosphere of ease and calm that complements the cultural weight of the surrounding Siem Reap temple region.

For international groups visiting Siem Reap with mixed-handicap compositions, where some players want maximum challenge (Angkor Golf Resort, Phokeethra) and others prefer a more rewarding social round, AGS often recommends Booyoung Country Club as the day where the group plays together comfortably. Everyone scores well, the environment is beautiful, and the post-round conversation over dinner focuses on temple experiences rather than golf frustrations.

curatorBriefHtml: Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Siem Reap, Cambodia, crafted by Kentaro Sato (2009) and stretching to 6,963 Yards (Blue Tees) across a tropical, relaxing, scenic environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its extensive floral landscaping & watercourses (Vibrant tropical garden feel) and strategic bunkering & elevated greens (Tests high-iron approaches).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club (Near Angkor Wat temples) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Cambodia dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie line-reading warmth (Polite and helpful advice), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Siem Reap golf tour by AGS, Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club provides a distinct architectural test by Kentaro Sato that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club?
faqs.a: Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club in Siem Reap, Cambodia is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Kentaro Sato (opened 2009), measuring 6,963 Yards (Blue Tees) within a tropical, relaxing, scenic setting. It is particularly noted for extensive floral landscaping & watercourses (Vibrant tropical garden feel).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club?
faqs.a: Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club operates under near angkor wat temples protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie line-reading warmth (Polite and helpful advice)), and private VIP transfers from your Siem Reap hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club's strategic bunkering & elevated greens (Tests high-iron approaches) alongside extensive floral landscaping & watercourses (Vibrant tropical garden feel). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.a: November through May is ideal for Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club.
